logs.title: How to Earn Logs
logs.introTitle: Save up Logs to cheer for works you love
logs.introCopy: Plant a tree, top up your balance, or join community events — find the way that works for you.
logs.illustrationAlt: Illustration of LogGirl planting a tree, topping up, and joining community events

tree.title: Plant in the Log Tree Farm
tree.description: Start with a sapling, grow trees in your own tree farm, and harvest Logs when they mature.
tree.step1: Enter the Log Tree Farm and plant a sapling
tree.step2: Follow the tree farm prompts to tend the tree until it matures
tree.step3: Harvest the tree to add Logs to your balance

recharge.title: Top up Logs
recharge.description: Want to support a work right away? Top up to add Logs to your balance.
recharge.step1: Open the top-up page and choose a Log amount
recharge.step2: Confirm the order and complete payment as prompted
recharge.step3: After payment, check your Log balance and order history
recharge.step4: Your top-up also supports community maintenance and operations

activity.title: Join community events
activity.description: Watch for community event announcements and join events with Log rewards for more creative fun.
activity.step1: Check event messages to see what's running
activity.step2: Read the requirements, deadline, and reward details
activity.step3: Join according to the rules; rewards follow the event announcement

logs.noteTitle: Send Logs to creators you love
logs.noteCopy: Once you have Logs, go back to a work and choose a gift to tip it. Tree Farm earnings, top-up amounts, and event rewards are subject to the notes on their respective pages.

giftCode.inputTips: Gift codes are 16 letters and digits
giftCode.tip1: Enter a valid gift code and tap "Redeem now"
giftCode.tip2: After verification, the matching Logs will be added to your account automatically
giftCode.tip3: Each gift code can be used only once
giftCode.tip4: If you have any issues, contact our official WeChat support: CodesOcean
